evidence_proves_hypothesis: At chr14q12, SCFD1 (C015-N1) colocalizes with AnswerALS-594 iPSC-MN ISL1-footprint eQTL rs229143-A (AF=0.329, beta=+0.048, padj<2e-32; AVI Phred=10.27; GTEx BA9 +0.269) AND pooled N=261 human iPSC-microglia (iMGL) eQTLs where SCFD1 is the sole chr14q12 microglial ALS colocalization (PP_H4=0.876-0.890 across untreated/IFN/LPS at rs229194-A/rs229195-A AF=0.337, 0 G2E3 signal) and sole hit shared with primary microglia (lowering iMGL SCFD1 -0.224 to -0.333 with null NeuroKO phagocytosis KO FDR=0.928; Perez-Alcantara et al. 2026 Nat Genet PMID:43045849, 10.1038/s41588-026-02843-0), while adjacent G2E3 (C015-N2) combines exon-2 sQTL rs229190 (padj<6e-32; AVI Phred=7.61) and 5/5-study TDP-43 Intron-1 cryptic ALE (dPSI=+0.4044, FDR=2.90e-21). Open Targets SuSiE-inf (purityMeanR2=0.988, EUR-vs-xAnc GWAS COLOC H4=0.958, PMID:34873335) and phased 1000G Phase 3 chromosomes show rs229243-A, cross-ancestry lead rs229195-A (PIP=0.240), rs229194-A, and rs229143-A have 96.7% (351/363) 1111 A-haplotype purity in EUR vs 72.7% (853/1,173; 320 mixed) in AFR (gnomAD NFE AF=32.6-32.9%, EAS=60.4-61.3%).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: G2E3 Intron-1 cryptic ALE windows (#1 chr14:30563747-30563764(+) & #2 chr14:30563930-30563947(+)) map inside an Alu/SINE retroelement and fail 0mm transcriptome safety (375 spliced + 7,211 pre-mRNA 0mm hits on #1; 1 spliced + 37 pre-mRNA 0mm hits + constrained ELOC 1mm on #2; #3 hits constrained ELOC 1-nt bulge), NYGC bulk G2E3 cryptic detection is 0.54% (5/926 vs 0/750, selective=False) with null Ribo-seq (padj=0.890) and undetected cortical DIA protein (0 human G2E3 Q7L622 PDBs; AF-Q7L622-F1 only, with PHD2/3 RINGs catalytically active and HECT inactive per Brooks et al. 2008 PMID:18511420), SCFD1 (0 human Q8WVM8 PDBs; AF-Q8WVM8-F1 + rat 1Y9J / yeast Sly1p PDB 1MQS PMID:12426383) is pan-essential in DepMap (Chronos=-1.2619; gnomAD v4.1 MANE ENST00000458591 LOEUF=0.809 vs Open Targets v2.1.1 0.472) with opposing MN vs iMGL eQTL polarity and null cortical DIA protein (p=0.931/0.797), and CHEMBL3752910 (SCFD1 Kd=171 nM) is a promiscuous EPHA3 kinase inhibitor (IC50=0.3 nM).
factual_justification: Human chr14q12 ALS GWAS/eQTL/sQTL convergence on SCFD1 and G2E3 remains mechanistically unresolved across cell types: G2E3 Alu cryptic windows are excluded from steric SSOs due to catastrophic 0mm off-target hybridization, while allele-phased MN (+0.048) vs microglial (-0.22 to -0.33) SCFD1 eQTL opposition and Chronos=-1.26 essentiality require bidirectional CRISPRi/CRISPRa effector dissection.
discriminating_next_test: Exclude Alu-derived G2E3 windows (#1/#2 FAIL_EXACT_0MM_OFFTARGET, #3 WARN ELOC) from steric SSOs and execute bidirectional CRISPRi/CRISPRa dissection of chr14q12 SCFD1 vs G2E3 across paired isogenic human iPSC-MNs and LPS-stimulated human iMGL measuring ER-Golgi secretory and lysosomal-enzyme trafficking (given N=261 iMGL sole chr14q12 SCFD1 colocalization PP_H4=0.876-0.890, opposing MN vs myeloid eQTL polarity, null phagocytosis KO FDR=0.928 in PMID:43045849, and SCFD1 Chronos=-1.26).

name: FBXL5
evidence_proves_hypothesis: TDP-43 depletion induces coordinated distal 3'UTR lengthening of BOTH FBXL5 (chr4:15604539:-, dPAS=+0.0873, padj=4.45e-4) and its direct substrate IREB2/IRP2 (chr15:78501450:+, dPAS=+0.1279, padj=3.02e-24) alongside FTH1 (dPAS=+0.0785, S4 padj=5.31e-45) and ACO1 (dPAS=+0.0948, padj=0.00883) plus TFRC/FTL KD mRNA upregulation; postmortem tissues show GC-adjusted NYGC FBXL5 RNA elevation (GC=37.97%: Motor n=205 adj_beta=+0.1758, p=3.38e-5; Frontal n=257 +0.1342, p=3.22e-5; Spinal n=262 +0.1990, p=8.03e-4), Spillman MOESM1 cortical DIA iron-axis remodeling (Synaptosome TFRC log2FC=-1.2067, p=7.08e-4, padj=0.109; Homogenate IREB2 -0.6213, p=0.0259; Homogenate ACO1 +0.4150, p=0.0071), and elevated CSF ceruloplasmin (DIA p=0.0273). PDB 3V5Z (aa 1-161 [Fe-O-Fe] degron) and cryo-EM PDB 6VCD (aa 199-691 LRR [2Fe-2S] coordinated by Cys662/676/686/687 at 2.84-2.99A, Wang et al. 2020 PMID:32126207) prove FBXL5 requires dual iron cofactors to recruit IRP2.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Two major findings rule out unidirectional neuronal IRP2 degradation while retaining bidirectional sensor probing: (1) Cell-type & polarity split: donor-collapsed snRNA-seq shows FBXL5 mRNA is flat in sALS excitatory neurons (Pineda BA9_Exc p=0.628, BA4_Exc p=0.208; Edinburgh Exc +0.1266, p=0.1751, n=34) while upregulated in microglia (Edinburgh donor-collapsed n=33 diff=+0.4591, p=0.00334) and astrocytes (BA4_Astro +0.246, p=0.0316), whereas neuronal TFRC (-0.3144, p_welch=0.0508, p_mwu=0.0275 in Edinburgh Exc; -1.21 in Spillman synaptosomes) and cortical IREB2 protein (-0.621, p=0.0259) are ALREADY depleted (FBXL5 protein undetected in DIA), meaning further neuronal IRP2 degradation or IREB2 ASO knockdown risks OMIM 618451 functional iron starvation; (2) Bulk iron chelation (Deferiprone 2.5 uM, ~13 uM free brain) failed in 16 sALS iPSC-MN lines (paired vs DMSO +0.2430d, p=0.3751, Wilcoxon p=0.6322, q_BH=0.5575, Rank #47/107), ALS Phase 2/3 FAIR-ALS II (NCT03293069, N=372, 30 mg/kg/d) remains unreported (hasResults=false), and unmedicated PD FAIRPARK-II worsened motor scores (Devos et al. 2022 NEJM PMID:36449420).
factual_justification: Deferiprone's failure falsifies non-selective iron chelation (which strips [Fe-O-Fe]/[2Fe-2S] out of FBXL5) while leaving cell-type-resolved FBXL5-IRP2 sensor polarity in human ALS motor neurons vs iron-loaded microglia untested; pivoted from unidirectional neuronal IRP2 degradation (wrong-sign OMIM 618451 risk) to a Tier 3 bidirectional FBXL5-IRP2 iron-sensor probe watchlist.
discriminating_next_test: Execute a bidirectional cell-type-resolved sign test (CRISPRi/CRISPRa + non-chelating tool probes distinguishing aa 1-161 hemerythrin degron stabilization [PDB 3V5Z] from aa 199-691 [2Fe-2S] Cys662/676/686/687 FBXL5-IRP2 recruitment [PDB 6VCD, PMID:32126207]) across human sALS iPSC-MNs and iron-loaded human iMGL co-cultures (with Deferiprone 2.5 uM as negative control), measuring labile Fe2+, mitochondrial Fe-S aconitase activity, TFRC/ferritin translation, and ferroptotic sensitivity to determine whether ALS motor neurons suffer functional iron starvation vs overload before any lead chemistry.

name: CHIT1 / GPNMB / CHI3L1-CHI3L2 microglial chitinase-lysosomal staging axis
technical_accuracy_of_explore_claim: VERIFIED_QUANTITATIVELY: Re-computation in Trautwig 4-center CSF DIA (total N=259: Emory 118, MGH 78, WashU 32, UMilan 31; sALS n=50 vs Ctrl n=72) & Emory TMT (N=101) and Oh 2023 confirms symptomatic-only elevation across all 4 purple-module proteins (CHIT1 q=3.24e-09, BatchOLS +1.7955, p=2.51e-08; CHI3L2 q=2.29e-09; CHI3L1 q=8.04e-04; GPNMB q=0.00162, BatchOLS +0.3328, p=0.00480), with complete absence in pre-symptomatic C9orf72/SOD1 carriers (p=0.2937-0.9918). NYGC Cervical M3 cell-comp OLS (n=198) confirms CHIT1 (+2.4285, p=1.62e-10) and GPNMB (+2.2014, p=1.90e-18) reflect true DAM induction, whereas CHI3L1 (+0.0876, p=0.7517) and CHI3L2 (+0.3345, p=0.1769) track reactive gliosis.
causal_vs_reactive_assessment: REACTIVE_BIOMARKER_AND_COMPENSATORY_PROTECTIVE: Human germline CHIT1 knockout (Exon-10 24-bp duplication rs3831317, AF=0.2200, 40,441 gnomAD homozygotes; 9% [6/65] ALS homozygotes with undetectable CSF CHIT1 in Steinacker 2021 PMID:33576252; Pagliardini 2015 PMID:25563799) does not protect against ALS risk or slow progression; GPNMB (#1 PD 7p15 L2G=0.492, PMID:35981040) rescues SOD1/TDP-43 motor neurons (PMID:22891158, PMID:27935101) so inhibition inverts the therapeutic sign; CHI3L1/CHI3L2 are non-catalytic pseudochitinases (CHI3L2 lacks a mouse ortholog).
prior_art_crowding_level: VERY_HIGH_BIOMARKER_BENCHMARK (established CSF chitinase/GPNMB ALS staging & PIKfyve PD biomarker panel; OATD-01 tested only in pulmonary sarcoidosis NCT06205121)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Cross-platform replication across Trautwig 4-center DIA/TMT CSF (PMID:40375307), Oh 2023 CSF (PMID:37238921; plus longitudinal CSF progression modeling in Vu et al. 2023 PMID:37646115), clinical immunoassays (Thompson 2019 PMID:31123140 AUC up to 0.92 vs healthy controls vs ~0.688-0.84 vs neurological mimics in Steinacker 2018 PMID:29142138), NYGC spinal cord, Edinburgh snRNA-seq, and Zhang TDP-43+ spatial niches establishes the 4-protein panel as a validated CSF symptomatic-vs-presymptomatic staging, ALS-Glia stratification, and lysosomal target-engagement (VRG50635 PMID:41708347) biomarker suite.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Natural human CHIT1 null homozygosity (rs3831317: 9% [6/65] ALS cases in Steinacker 2021 PMID:33576252; Pagliardini 2015 PMID:25563799; Project MinE GWAS null PMID:34873335) confers neither ALS protection nor survival benefit (while causing ~5-10% false-negative CSF CHIT1 reads if ungenotyped), endogenous GPNMB is neuroprotective in SOD1/TDP-43 models (Tanaka 2012 PMID:22891158; Nagahara 2017 PMID:27935101 — wrong sign for inhibition), and CHI3L1/CHI3L2 lack catalytic activity.
factual_justification: All four sub-nodes (C017-N1..N4) replicate across MS and clinical immunoassays as a validated CSF symptomatic-vs-presymptomatic staging and glial/lysosomal pharmacodynamic panel (flat in pre-symptomatic C9orf72/SOD1 carriers, p=0.29-0.97), but fail therapeutic target criteria: human genetic CHIT1 deficiency (rs3831317, PMID:33576252) does not alter ALS risk or progression, GPNMB is compensatory/neuroprotective (PMID:22891158, PMID:27935101), and CHI3L1/CHI3L2 are catalytically inactive pseudochitinases.
discriminating_next_test: Deploy mandatory rs3831317-genotyped (PMID:33576252) CSF Simoa/Ella/ELISA CHIT1 + GPNMB + CHI3L1/CHI3L2 as a quantitative symptomatic-vs-presymptomatic staging, ALS-Glia enrichment, and microglial/lysosomal pharmacodynamic panel (benchmarking mimic specificity ~0.688-0.84 alongside NfL/pNfH, PMID:29142138) rather than pursuing chitinase or GPNMB inhibition.

name: Classical Complement C1q (C1QA/C1QB/C1QC Intrathecal Blockade)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Zhang 2026 6i_TDP43_ALS_vs._HC cervical 55-um multicellular anterior-horn Visium spots (N=14 donors) show focal C1QA/B/C upregulation (C1QA +0.9733 [bh_fdr=7.36e-06], C1QB +1.2965 [bh_fdr=1.24e-05], C1QC +1.1986 [bh_fdr=7.60e-09]; 6d_MN niche C1QC +2.37 [bh_fdr=1.04e-10], C1QB +1.62 [3.49e-6], C1QA +1.49 [2.76e-4]), and Scott-Hewitt et al. (Cell 2024, PMID:38942014, 10.1016/j.cell.2024.05.058; PDB 1PK6 1.85A gC1q head PMID:12960167 vs AFDB mature N-terminal CLR stalk [C1QA aa 23-109, C1QB aa 28-114, C1QC aa 29-112: 27 mature Arg/Lys basic residues per heterotrimer, 30 up to aa 114] distinguishing anti-gC1q Fab from C1QA/B ASO) establishes C3-independent neuronal C1q endocytosis and RNA-dependent LLPS into neuronal RNP/polysome complexes.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Bulk spinal RNA and living-CSF C1q/C4B shifts largely reflect glial proportion, center offset, or multi-copy RCCX C4B short-read CNV mapping artifacts (C4B DIA p=0.0568, q=0.3369; ~2-3% healthy European C4B*Q0 homozygosity refutes apparent LOEUF=0.257/0.413); systemic C1q ablation carries >90% SLE/encapsulated-sepsis liability — in HD Phase 2 NCT04514367 (N=28, PMC13307253, PMID:41787606), IV ANX005 (75-100 mg/kg) saturated baseline CSF C1q at 0.2-0.25% CSF:serum penetration but caused 3/28 (10.7%) autoimmune SAE withdrawals via peripheral 180 nM serum C1q sink ablation (while open-label ALS NCT04569435 N=17 remains unpublished); IV BBB-TfR-shuttled IgG likewise depletes 99.99% of 180 nM serum C1q [MODEL_PRIOR] while unmodified q4w IT 48 kDa Fab clears via ~4x/day CSF turnover; and global C1qa KO failed to extend SOD1 mouse survival while worsening cholinergic C-bouton loss (Lobsiger et al. 2013 PMID:24170856).
factual_justification: Per Epistemic Asymmetry, systemic C3 failure in MERIDIAN (C024, <0.1% intact-BBB entry) did not test CNS parenchymal C1q or C3-independent neuronal C1q RNP biology (Scott-Hewitt et al. 2024, 10.1016/j.cell.2024.05.058), whereas RCCX comparator C4B is confounded/null. Because systemic IV IgG/BBB shuttles hit the 180 nM serum C1q sink and unmodified q4w IT Fab washes out (t1/2 ~12 h), C018 is retained in Tier 3 strictly for half-life-extended intrathecal C1q blockade gated on spinal C-bouton preservation.
discriminating_next_test: Engineer ECM-anchored half-life-extended intrathecal anti-C1q Fab/nanobody or intrathecal microglial C1QA/B 2'-O-MOE ASO/di-siRNA (rejecting systemic IV ANX005, IV BBB-shuttled IgG, and unmodified q4w IT 48 kDa Fab) and gate on preserved cholinergic C-bouton (SLC18A3/SLC5A7) and neuronal RNP proteostasis in adult spinal cord models (PMID:24170856; 10.1016/j.cell.2024.05.058).

name: Baricitinib
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Rank #2/107 in Bye 2025 pure sALS iPSC-MNs (+3.774d, 14/16 lines, p=2.56e-7, q=6.85e-6); TDP-43 KD induces neuronal JAK2 3'UTR shortening (dPAS=-0.4391, padj=2.96e-61) & AAK1 lengthening (dPAS=+0.1673, padj=6.32e-16) replicated by Edinburgh excitatory JAK2 upregulation (+0.4907, p=0.0457, n=34); NYGC ALS-Glia enriches gp130/OSMR->JAK1/2->STAT3 (cortex z_diff=+0.7031, p=6.27e-4, AUC=0.7893; cord z_diff=+0.4169, p=1.91e-6, AUC=0.7186); 24-wk open-label NADALS (NCT05189106, N=9 ALS enrolled, 5/9 completers; 2 mg QD Wk1-8 -> 4 mg QD Wk9-24; LPs Wk0/8/16 2h post-dose, n=8 PK) showed 3.80 nM Wk16 CSF entry with descriptive -38.1% CSF CXCL10 reduction and stable CSF NfL (5523->5796->5504 pg/mL).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: P-gp/BCRP efflux limits Kp,uu,CSF to ~0.05-0.11 (3.80 nM CSF = 0.095x whole-cell pSTAT IC50 ~40 nM [~8.7% cellular occupancy]; 657x below 2.5 uM screen); NADALS ALS had 1/9 PE SAE + 1/9 DVT event (1-2/9 [11.1-22.2%] ALS participants; un-deduplicated in NCT05189106 aggregate AE table; 2 AEs rated Possibly Related, 0 Probably/Definitely Related; 4/9 non-completers); structural/mechanistic JAK1-vs-neuronal-JAK2 catch-22 where JAK2-sparing selective JAK1 JH1 inhibitors forfeit TDP-43-induced autonomous neuronal JAK2 survival rescue (if 2.5 uM Bye rescue requires neuronal JAK2 or saturating AAK1/kinome polypharmacology) whereas retaining JAK2 hits EPO/TPO and JAK1/2 VTE walls; allosteric TYK2-JH2 spares gp130/OSMR->JAK1/2->STAT3 (cord TypeI-IFN/TYK2 axis p=0.843, AUC=0.508) and neuronal JAK2; shotgun MS CSF CXCL10 suffers left-censored MNAR/tryptic scarcity (31.3% DIA / 84.2% TMT missing), is Emory-matched center-null (symp_als p=0.838, sALS p=0.602), and is orthogonal (DIA r=+0.0517, TMT r=-0.366) to the 4-protein high-chitinase CSF glial panel; gnomAD v4.1 MANE JAK1 LOEUF=0.168, JAK2 LOEUF=0.848 (Open Targets 0.178/0.739) + FDA Boxed Warnings bar unstratified chronic dosing.
factual_justification: Human ALS CSF CXCL10 target engagement (-38.1% at 4 mg/d) and neuronal TDP-43 JAK2 3'UTR APA + pure-MN survival rescue alongside gp130/OSMR->JAK1/2->STAT3 ALS-Glia enrichment forbid DROP under Epistemic Asymmetry, but C019 is recalibrated to the Tier 3 exploratory watchlist because 3.80 nM CSF (~8.7% cellular pSTAT occupancy) is 657x below the 2.5 uM screen, NADALS recorded 1/9 PE SAE + 1/9 DVT event across N=9 ALS participants (un-deduplicated in aggregate registry), and JAK2-sparing selective JAK1 inhibition creates a mechanistic catch-22 by forfeiting cell-autonomous neuronal JAK2 coverage.
discriminating_next_test: Resolve the JAK1-vs-neuronal-JAK2 catch-22 at clinically reachable unbound human CSF concentrations (3.8-50 nM; ~8.7% whole-cell pSTAT occupancy at 3.8 nM vs 39-40% cell-free JAK1/2) by testing Baricitinib vs Kp,uu-verified homodimeric-JAK2 (EPO/TPO)-sparing selective JAK1 JH1 inhibitors and CRISPRi JAK1/JAK2/AAK1 knockdowns across BOTH glia-free sALS iPSC-MNs (testing whether 2.5 uM rescue vanishes at 4-50 nM or upon JAK2 sparing) and reactive ALS-Glia co-cultures — barring co-dosing with low-dose IL-2 (EALS-031) and mandating VTE thromboprophylaxis — before any high-chitinase CSF glial-stratum-stratified (rs3831317-neutral sALS-p80) interaction trial.

name: Apilimod
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Apilimod (free base CHEMBL4297643 MW 418.49 Da; preclinical PIKfyve ALS validation Hung et al. 2023 Cell PMID:36754049) rescues mean Bye 2025 sALS iPSC-MN survival at 2.5 uM (+1.837d, 12/16 lines, p=0.00210, q=0.0173); AIT-101 dimesylate 125 mg BID (MW 610.70 Da, fu,p<0.01) in C9orf72-ALS (NCT05163886, N=15) reached 283.13 ng/mL Wk12 1h plasma (n=9/10; Wk24 OG000 315.40 ng/mL, n=5) and 3.89 nM CSF (n=10, Kp,uu~0.72), cutting 12-wk randomized CSF poly(GP) by 74.4% with CSF NfL -5.0% (6,706.8->6,372.7 pg/mL vs +9.1% pbo) and 0 drug-related SAEs.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Trautwig 2025 CSF GDI2 is quantified and non-significant in sALS vs Ctrl (DIA diff_log2=+0.0200, p=0.5042, n=122 within N=259; TMT +0.0245, p=0.2085; C9 only p=0.00598/0.0268); 4/16 (25%, 0 ties) sALS lines worsened at 2.5 uM; NCT05163886 CSF sGPNMB was unchanged (p=0.352) while Wk12 Plasma NfL rose +39.2% & Wk24 OLE CSF NfL rose +49.7% (n=4), and daily PIKfyve inhibitor VRG50635 caused 2/6 (33%) MAD drug-related encephalopathy/renal SAEs in NL81735.056.22 (PMID:41708347, PMC12916242; HV NCT06286475 N=22 completed) plus astrocytic GFAP+NfL co-elevation & 8/54 (14.8%) drug SAEs in 400-800 mg QD ALS Ph1b NCT06215755 (TERMINATED; PIKFYVE gnomAD v4.1 MANE LOEUF=0.523, MGI brain vacuoles), refuting benign exosome-flushing for continuous QD/BID dosing.
factual_justification: 12-wk randomized C9orf72-ALS target engagement (-74.4% CSF poly(GP), -5.0% CSF NfL, N=15 unpowered) and untested sALS status forbid DROP, but continuous PIKfyve blockade hits a human vacuolation/encephalopathy/NfL+GFAP toxicity wall.
discriminating_next_test: Empirically calibrate PI(3,5)P2 regeneration, ClC-7 vacuole-clearance, ATG16L1-catalyzed LC3B CASM conjugation, and LRRK2 pRab10-Thr73 washout half-lives over a strict 14-day falsification gate in C9orf72 and sALS iPSC-MNs to resolve the bifurcated q48h-q72h single-pulse nanomolar Apilimod (CHEMBL4297643) sensitivity (6.5-8.0 nM unbound Cmax passes [MODEL_PRIOR] ~79% [64/81] in decoupled dead-zone Model 1 vs ~30% [24/81] at matched 10-20h repair and 0% [0/81] at 24-48h postmitotic repair in zero-dead-zone coupled +PI(3)P->LRRK2/CASM Model 2; reconciling -PI(3,5)P2 -> ClC-7 osmotic swelling + Rab/LRRK2 hyperactivation [Clegg et al. 2026 PMID:42900584] and +PI(3)P -> direct LRRK2 + CASM amplification [Kuwahara et al. 2026 PMID:42994990, 10.26508/lsa.202603939]), co-measuring paired intracellular vs conditioned-media secreted poly(GP)/pTDP-43 mass-balance (PMID:27732842; Drosophila C9orf72 model 10.64898/2026.11.09.765393 [PREPRINT]), nanomolar-to-2.5 uM potency bridging, and fast axonal transport: advance ONLY if pulsed dosing achieves >50% net clearance with <5% ClC-7 vacuolation, tau <24 h CASM/pRab10 washout, and zero NfL/GFAP surge.

name: Icerguastat (IFB-088 / Sephin1)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Modest survival gain at 2.5 uM in Bye 2025 sALS iPSC-MNs (+1.618d, 13/16 lines, p=0.00202, q=0.0173); Zeng 2025 PPP1R15A dPAS=+0.0558 (padj=6.42e-8).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Chemical registry audit refuted misattributed IDs (verified Sephin1=CHEMBL2365743 / CID:9561611, free-base MW 196.64, acetate MW 256.69); direct PPP1R15A-PP1c holophosphatase inhibition was biochemically refuted (Crespillo-Casado et al. 2017/2018 PMID:28447936, PMID:29618508; cellular activity reflects 1-5 uM GluN2B NAM [Abgueguen et al. 2026 PMID:43036320] & PHB2 [Ding et al. 2026 PMID:42790826], failing SOD1-G93A mice in Vieira et al. 2024 PMID:38359044); in Phase 2 NCT05508074 (N=51 bulbar ALS, 25 mg BID + riluzole), extreme apparent oral clearance (CL/F=580 L/h; Ph1 736-1,388 L/h) capped measured total plasma GeoMean Cmax at 12.0 ng/mL = 61.0 nM (Ph1 35.2 nM — already 41-71x below 2.5 uM in total plasma; [MODEL_PRIOR] Cu,brain ~5-20 nM = 125-500x gap) with flat plasma GDF15 (~704 pg/mL posted under CT.gov ng/mL header), null ITT ALSFRS-R (-0.33, p=0.923) & NfL ratio 1.04 (p=0.609), and 5/34 (14.7%) vs 2/17 (11.8%) total fatal TEAEs including 2/34 (5.9% vs 0%) drug-related fatal TEAEs and 8/34 (23.5% vs 0%) falls.
factual_justification: Falsified by a non-closable human PK/safety wall and refuted primary target: extreme oral clearance (CL/F=580-1,388 L/h) caps measured human total plasma Cmax at 35.2-61.0 nM (41-71x below 2.5 uM even before protein binding; [MODEL_PRIOR] Cu,brain ~5-20 nM = 125-500x below 2.5 uM & 1-5 uM GluN2B/PHB2 activity, PMID:28447936, PMID:43036320) with flat human GDF15 and null ITT ALSFRS-R (p=0.923) / NfL (p=0.609) in Phase 2 NCT05508074 (N=51), while 25 mg BID already recorded 2/34 (5.9% vs 0%) drug-related fatal TEAEs (5/34 vs 2/17 all-cause) and 23.5% falls.

name: DNAJB2 (HSJ1) Cytosolic vs. ER-Prenylated Isoform Axis
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Recessive human DNAJB2 loss-of-function variants (55 Open Targets EVA/ClinVar submissions, 25/25 (100%) single-gene GRCh38 P/LP variants in shared Exons 2-9 vs 0/25 in Zone A, OMIM 614881; Chen et al. 2016 Brain PMID:26936937; dominant stop-loss c.832T>G ER-trapping neuromyopathy PMID:37070754) cause distal hereditary motor neuropathy (dHMN5/CMT2T) and juvenile ALS, cytosolic DNAJB2a clears ubiquitylated TDP-43 aggregates, and human ALS/FTD tissue shows GC-adjusted cortical oligodendrocyte (-0.745, p=3.46e-7 in BA9; -0.618, p=2.59e-4 in BA4), NYGC cervical cord (-0.293, p=5.21e-5, n=86: 48 non-mutation sALS vs 38 Ctrl), Spillman MOESM1 C9-FTD cortical homogenate (-0.4470, p=3.05e-4, BH-FDR=0.0182, n=20) & synaptosome (-0.3818, p=0.00813, BH-FDR=0.2236, n=20; PMID:42789089), and iPSC-neuron (-1.115, p=0.0455, n=6) depletion. Primary 6-cohort splicing/APA scan confirms 0 TDP-43 cryptic/APA events (i3Neuron RNA log2FC=+0.092, p=0.124, padj=0.283), and AF-P25686-F1 resolves 2 rigid domains (aa 1-73 & 164-223, pLDDT=67.38; gnomAD v4.1 MANE ENST00000336576.10 LOEUF=0.836 vs cytosolic ENST00000392086.8 LOEUF=0.743).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Edinburgh cortical oligodendrocyte snRNA-seq is underpowered/non-significant (-0.397, p=0.447, n=33), NYGC motor cortex bulk RNA is flat (+0.087, p=0.401), CSF TMT is null (p=0.779), motor-neuron vs oligodendrocyte compartment dominance is unresolved, internal Intron-9 sequence (chr2:219284988-219285939(+), 952 bp sparing 5'SS 219284836-219284845, Zone A CDS/stop 219284836-219284987, and BP/PPT/3'SS 219285940-219285986 whose blockade would prevent Exon-10 splicing and force DNAJB2b!) lacks mapped ISS/intronic-polyadenylation (IPA) cis-elements, and internal Intron-9 windows sit inside the mature cytoplasmic 3'-UTR of ER-prenylated (-CVVQ) DNAJB2b mRNA where steric/shift effects risk depleting ERAD-essential DNAJB2b.
factual_justification: Anchored by human Mendelian motor-neuropathy/juvenile-ALS genetics (OMIM 614881, 25/25 single-gene GRCh38 ClinVar P/LP variants; 55 Open Targets EVA submissions) and concordant human cortical oligodendrocyte, cervical spinal cord, and synaptosomal protein loss; retained in Tier 3 Exploratory Discovery pending sALS spinal isoform precursor quantification, Intron-9 ISS-vs-ISE mapping, and ERAD DNAJB2b safety counter-screening.
discriminating_next_test: Quantify cytosolic DNAJB2a (ENST00000392086.8, 277 aa, excising 1,151-bp Intron 9 chr2:219284836-219285986(+)) vs Intron-9-retaining ER-prenylated DNAJB2b (ENST00000336576.10, 324 aa) precursor ratios by targeted PRM/RT-ddPCR in sporadic ALS spinal cord, and benchmark intrathecal pan-CNS/oligodendrocyte-tropic AAV-DNAJB2a cDNA replacement (cellular HSJ1a precedent PMID:26936937) against an internal Intron-9 2'-O-MOE ISS/IPA-competition microwalk restricted to chr2:219284988-219285939(+) (sparing 5'SS, Zone A CDS, and 3'SS/branchpoint chr2:219285940-219285986(+)) with mature DNAJB2b 3'-UTR stability and BiP/HSPA5 + CHOP/DDIT3 ERAD counter-screens in sALS iPSC-MN/oligodendrocyte co-cultures.

name: YKT6 (p.Tyr64Cys Longin R-SNARE)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: YKT6 (C023-N1) converges across exome-wide rare ALS risk variant p.Tyr64Cys (chr7:44206388:A>G, rs138273846 on ENST00000223369.9; Hop et al. PMID:41917433 discovery OR=2.84, P=9.08e-8, meta P=1.50e-9; AlphaGenome AVI Phred=24.53, top 0.352%), direct 3.46A heavy-atom contact of Tyr64 to acyl ligand DPV201 inside Rattus norvegicus closed DPC-bound Ykt6 PDB 3KYQ (Wen et al. 2010 PMID:20159557 [Ortholog/Detergent-Analog Inferred], 4.29A from Cys66; vs human open GGTase-III:YKT6 PDB 6J74 PMID:32128853), TDP-43 3'UTR lengthening (dPAS=+0.1417, padj=4.57e-40), TDP-43 frameshifting 170-bp Exon-2 skip in geranylgeranyltransferase-III subunit PTAR1 (ENST00000340434.5 chr9:69750781-69750950(-), mod_3=2, group E(PSI) 0.156->0.369 [raw diff +0.213; MAJIQ shrunk dPSI=+0.1563], FDR=3.26e-6; synaptosomal PTAR1 +0.576, p=0.0158), and sALS cortical excitatory neuronal mRNA reduction (BA9 -0.464, p=4.53e-4; BA4 -0.285, p=0.0263; NYGC Motor adj beta=-0.080, p=0.035).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: YKT6 is pan-essential across 1,258 DepMap lines (mean Chronos=-1.5425, 93.8% <-1.0; gnomAD v4.1 MANE LOEUF=0.636; biallelic human YKT6 LoF disorder Ma et al. 2024 PMID:38522068) with zero known chemical ligands, p.Tyr64Cys (rs138273846) has gnomAD v4.1 Joint AC=982/1,613,908 (AF=0.061%, 0 homozygotes; NFE AF=0.071% [~1:704 carriers, moderate-effect risk allele rather than high-penetrance dominant fALS]) while the rat PDB 3KYQ Tyr64->Cys64 pocket expansion ([MODEL_PRIOR] +85.1 A^3 cavity / -85.1 A^3 side-chain delta) risks sterically ejecting endogenous Cys195-farnesyl in >99.9% WT sALS, C9-FTD synaptosomal YKT6 DIA is null (+0.1513, p=0.2842, n=20), and cis-Golgi SNARE/recycling comparators (SEC22B, STX5, GOSR1, NSF, GDI2) show null human ALS protein/CSF shifts alongside pan-essentiality (NSF Chronos=-2.44, DEE96; STX5 Chronos=-1.13, STX5-CDG).
factual_justification: Backed by rare human ALS coding genetics (YKT6 p.Tyr64Cys meta P=1.50e-9) and convergent TDP-43 APA + PTAR1 prenylation pathology, while extreme pan-essentiality (Chronos=-1.54) and null/toxic cis-Golgi SNARE partners (NSF, STX5, SEC22B, GOSR1, GDI2) restrict C023 to positive allele-split Longin conformational stabilization behind 4 structural and selectivity hurdles.
discriminating_next_test: Execute allele-split biophysical discovery: (1) in rare (<0.1% ALS; gnomAD NFE AF=0.071%) YKT6 p.Tyr64Cys (rs138273846) knock-in human iPSC-MNs ([MODEL_PRIOR] +85.1 A^3 Longin pocket expansion & 3.46A Cys64-Cys66 disulfide trap in rat DPC-bound PDB 3KYQ PMID:20159557 vs human open PDB 6J74 PMID:32128853), run 19F-NMR/DSF screening for ternary [YKT6-Cys195-farnesyl + fragment] co-occupancy without ejecting Cys195-farnesyl or inhibiting PTAR1; (2) in >99.9% WT YKT6 sALS, test exterior Longin exosite stabilizers or PTAR1 170-bp Exon-2 skipping rescue (chr9:69750781-69750950(-)) while counter-screening cis-Golgi SNARE assembly (STX5/GOSR1/SEC22B/NSF).

name: Pegcetacoplan (Systemic C3 Complement — MERIDIAN)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Focal C3 transcript elevation occurs within Zhang 2026 TDP-43+ cervical anterior-horn 55-um multicellular Visium spots (+1.2920, within-donor pseudoreplicated spot bh_fdr=5.82e-23 across N=14 donors, PMID:42135512), motivating clinical testing of systemic C3 complement inhibition.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 MERIDIAN trial (NCT04579666 posted results, N=249 started [169 vs 80] / N=247 mITT [168 pegcetacoplan 1,080 mg SC BIW vs 79 placebo]) missed Week 52 primary CAFS rank (123.0 [SE 4.71] vs 126.0 [SE 6.89]; ANCOVA LS mean diff -3.0, 95% CI -19.5 to +13.5, p=0.7205) and all secondary endpoints (ALSFRS-R p=0.6447, %SVC -6.6% p=0.0949, HHD p=0.0935, ALSAQ-40 +6.5 pts worse QoL p=0.0069) and terminated for futility, echoing systemic terminal C5 failures (Phase 3 CHAMPION-ALS ravulizumab NCT04248465 PMID:37695623; Phase 2/3 HEALEY zilucoplan NCT04436497 PMID:39960672), while living-CSF C3 fails proteome-wide FDR (DIA q=0.0708; TMT p=0.6225) and ~43.5 kDa PEGylated pegcetacoplan has <0.1% intact-BBB entry against hepatic C3 synthesis (GTEx Liver=1,575 TPM).
factual_justification: Directly falsified in a 249-patient randomized placebo-controlled Phase 2 ALS trial: subcutaneous systemic C3 inhibitor pegcetacoplan (MERIDIAN NCT04579666, N=249 started / N=247 mITT [168 vs 79]: Week 52 CAFS LS mean diff -3.0, p=0.7205; ALSFRS-R p=0.6447) missed primary and all secondary endpoints alongside Phase 3 ravulizumab (NCT04248465, PMID:37695623) and Phase 2/3 HEALEY zilucoplan (NCT04436497, PMID:39960672; strictly scoped to <0.1%-BBB systemic C3/C5 biologics, preserving CNS-compartmentalized intrathecal C1q blockade, PMID:42492371).

name: Dexmedetomidine
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Verified Bye 2025 2.5 uM paired rescue +1.3992d across 16 sALS lines (12/16 >0d, t=3.250, p=0.00538, q=0.03030, Rank #7/107).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: FDA NDA021038 (Precedex IV ICU infusion 0.2-0.7 ug/kg/h, MW 200.28, 94% bound -> Cu,plasma=0.09-0.37 nM; sublingual Igalmi NDA215390 23% somnolence / 18% orthostasis at Cu,p ~0.18 nM) and Talke et al. 1997 paired human lumbar CSF PK (PMID:9249114, PMID:9356115: ~0.20-0.35 nM CSF) prove tolerated human CNS exposure sits ~6,700-10,000x below the 2,500 nM screen and is gated by ADRA2A locus coeruleus unconsciousness, hypotension (25-54%), and sinus bradycardia/arrest (Ki ~1-2 nM; ADRA2A/B/C non-DE in Bye RNA-seq; oral alpha-2 agonist guanabenz had >30% ALS AE dropout in Phase 2 ProMISe, PMID:33905493).
factual_justification: Despite genuine 2.5 uM iPSC-MN rescue (+1.399d, q=0.0303), directly measured human unbound plasma (0.09-0.37 nM, NDA021038) and human lumbar CSF (~0.20-0.35 nM, Talke et al. 1997 PMID:9249114) sit ~6,700-10,000-fold below the 2.5 uM screen concentration and are capped by dose-limiting central alpha-2A sedation, hypotension, and bradycardia (corroborated by >30% oral alpha-2 intolerability in ALS ProMISe, PMID:33905493).

name: CuATSM
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Verified Bye 2025 2.5 uM paired rescue +1.3792d across 15 valid sALS lines (12/15 >0d, p=0.00631, q=0.03375, Rank #8/107; true ID CHEMBL4297372, fixing intake CHEMBL4297643 typo).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Randomized Phase 2/3 ALS trial NCT04082832 (72 mg/d oral, N=80 estimated, CT.gov status UNKNOWN) and completed open-label extension NCT04313166 (COMPLETED, N=55 actual) both withhold public clinical efficacy results (hasResults=false; sponsor discontinued ALS development), observational postmortem neuropathology of treated decedents (Yang et al. 2023 PMID:37317638, PMC10947464 Table 2: N=12 brains / n=11 spinal cords mixing 5 vs 4 sporadic ALS-TDP [% TDP-43+ motor-cortex neurons 0.9% vs 5.1%, p=0.1] + 1 vs 2 ALS-SOD1) showed no significant reduction in pTDP-43 or MN loss, [MODEL_PRIOR: 950 nM x fu 0.08 x Kp,uu 0.70 = 53.2 nM] sits ~47x below the 2.5 uM screen (bounded by 144 mg/d Phase 1 transaminitis in NCT02870634) while 62Cu/64Cu-ATSM PET (PMID:25904686) tracks hypoxic Cu(II)->Cu(I) reductive dissociation/transchelation rather than intact normoxic drug, and sporadic TDP-43 ALS lacks human genetic support for SOD1 copper chaperoning.
factual_justification: Withheld/unreported randomized Phase 2/3 outcomes in NCT04082832 (status UNKNOWN, hasResults=false) and completed OLE NCT04313166 (N=55 actual, hasResults=false) plus an underpowered mixed-genotype autopsy series (Yang 2023 PMID:37317638: 5 vs 4 ALS-TDP p=0.1 + 1 vs 2 ALS-SOD1) do not constitute published powered RCT futility; S02 (CHEMBL4297372) is retained on the low-priority Tier 3 watchlist behind 5 clinical, autopsy, PK ([MODEL_PRIOR] 53.2 nM = ~47x gap + Cu(I) transchelation), and mechanistic hurdles.
discriminating_next_test: Require public release and independent statistical audit of unblinded Phase 2/3 NCT04082832 ALSFRS-R/ECAS outcomes alongside 10-100 nM vs 2.5 uM intact unbound CuATSM concentration-response and radical-trapping ferroptosis target-engagement deconvolution in TDP-43-depleted human sALS iPSC-MNs before any renewed clinical consideration.

name: Mycophenolate mofetil
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Verified Bye 2025 2.5 uM paired rescue +1.2792d across 15 valid sALS lines (12/15 >0d, p=0.00293, q=0.02090, Rank #10/107; true IDs CHEMBL1456/CHEMBL866, fixing intake CHEMBL1230607 typo).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: At 1,000 mg PO BID transplant ceiling (NDA050722 CellCept: active MPA MW 320.34 is 97% albumin-bound, fu=0.03), human Cu,plasma,avg (~310-470 nM) sits 5.3-8.1x below 2.5 uM while >35x above lymphoid IMPDH2 Ki (~7-10 nM, PMID:7903306), and OAT3/MRP-effluxed anionic MPA (pKa 4.5) yields [MODEL_PRIOR] Cu,brain ~15-55 nM (45-165x below 2.5 uM neuronal screen); carries FDA Boxed Warnings (embryofetal toxicity, lymphoma/malignancies, serious infections) plus Section 5 PML/neutropenia warnings, and open-label Phase 2 ALS 4-drug immunosuppression trial NCT01884571 (Fournier et al. 2018 PMID:29308669: basiliximab + tacrolimus + MMF + prednisone, N=31) had 0/31 responders, no ALSFRS-R slowing vs pretreatment lead-in (p=0.200), and 42% AE dropouts.
factual_justification: Active mycophenolic acid faces a 45-165-fold [MODEL_PRIOR] human unbound CNS deficit (~15-55 nM vs 2,500 nM screen; 97% albumin binding fu=0.03, NDA050722, Cu,plasma ~310-470 nM) bounded by peripheral IMPDH2 cytostasis (Ki ~7-10 nM, PMID:7903306), FDA Boxed Warnings (serious infections, lymphoma, teratogenicity) + Section 5 PML risk, and 0/31 responders (p=0.200 vs pretreatment lead-in, 42% AE dropouts) in 4-drug ALS trial NCT01884571 (PMID:29308669; scoped to pan-lymphocyte IMPDH ablation, preserving low-dose IL-2 Treg expansion).

name: Tamoxifen
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Verified Bye 2025 2.5 uM paired rescue +1.2742d across 16 sALS lines (13/16 >0d, p=0.00316, q=0.02104, Rank #11/107).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Although total brain tamoxifen is 40-100x serum due to membrane/lysosomal lipid trapping (Lien et al. 1991 PMID:2021551, fu,brain <<0.0002; cLogP ~6.0-6.3, >99% bound), [MODEL_PRIOR] unbound aqueous brain exposure at 40-80 mg/d (~2.6 nM parent; ~3-15 nM combined with N-desmethyltamoxifen & P-gp-effluxed endoxifen) sits 165-800x below the 2.5 uM screen (a canonical cationic-amphiphilic phospholipidosis/PKC regime in low-protein media, Tummino et al. 2021 Science PMID:34326236); carries NDA021807 Boxed Warnings (stroke, pulmonary embolism, uterine malignancies), caused 5/38 (13.2%) VTEs (2 PEs, 3 DVTs) & 4/17 (23.5%) T80 deaths with untreated-rate ALSFRS-R decline in 38-wk placebo-less selection RCT NCT01257581 (Babu et al. 2020 PMID:31608711, N=60), and showed no durable 12-mo benefit in Chen et al. 2020 (PMID:32481440, NCT02166944, N=18) or NCT00214110 (N=100).
factual_justification: Combined parent + active metabolite [MODEL_PRIOR] unbound human brain exposure (~3-15 nM at 40-80 mg/d; Lien et al. 1991 PMID:2021551 lipid trapping) is 165-800-fold below the 2.5 uM in vitro cationic-amphiphilic phospholipidosis/PKC regime (Tummino et al. 2021 PMID:34326236), bounded by FDA Boxed Warnings (stroke, PE, uterine malignancy), 13.2% (5/38: 2 PE, 3 DVT) thromboembolism in ALS selection RCT NCT01257581 (Babu et al. 2020 PMID:31608711, N=60), and negative 12-mo ALS trials (PMID:32481440, NCT00214110).

name: Lonafarnib / Tipifarnib (FTIs)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Lonafarnib (CHEMBL298734, FTase IC50=1.9 nM) and Tipifarnib (CHEMBL289228, FTase IC50=0.57-0.90 nM) potently inhibit protein farnesyltransferase in biochemical assays and reduce mutant progerin/Rhes farnesylation in non-ALS models.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Falsified on three independent axes (0/107 in Bye 2025 screen): (1) Directional paradox: human GGTase-III (PTAR1/RABGGTB, PDB 6J74 PMID:32128853) strictly requires prior FTase Cys195 farnesylation to geranylgeranylate YKT6 Cys194 (pan-essential DepMap Chronos=-1.5425), so FTIs block YKT6 maturation and worsen TDP-43-driven YKT6 APA (padj=4.57e-40) + PTAR1 170-bp Exon-2 frameshifting skip (chr9:69750781-69750950(-), mod_3=2, dPSI=+0.1563, FDR=3.26e-6); (2) Unbound CNS PK deficit: Lonafarnib (NDA213969, MW 638.82, PPB>=99%) achieves Cmax,u<=42.2 nM at 150 mg/m2 BID and [MODEL_PRIOR] Cu,brain ~2.1-8.4 nM vs 70-500 nM cellular IC50 (Tipifarnib [MODEL_PRIOR] Cu,brain ~2-13 nM vs 2-75 nM sensitive-substrate IC50); (3) ALS-hostile human toxicity: Zokinvy Table 4 (N=63) records 90% vomiting, 81% diarrhea, 37% weight loss (prognostically lethal in ALS), 35% myelosuppression, +19 ms QTcF, and strong CYP3A autoinhibition, while Tipifarnib causes Grade 3/4 myelosuppression and neuropathy.
factual_justification: Dropped due to [MODEL_PRIOR] human unbound CNS exposure deficit (Lonafarnib Cu,brain ~2-8 nM vs 70-500 nM cellular IC50; Tipifarnib ~2-13 nM, NDA213969), ALS-hostile clinical toxicities (37% weight loss, 81-90% GI toxicity, 35% myelosuppression, +19 ms QTcF, neuropathic DLT; 0 Bye 2025 screen rows), and direct mechanistic antagonism of mandatory FTase Cys195 -> GGTase-III Cys194 dual prenylation on YKT6 (PDB 6J74 PMID:32128853) atop TDP-43 PTAR1 170-bp Exon-2 skipping (preserving pro-prenylation YKT6/PTAR1 rescue in C023).

name: SARM1 (Axonal NADase)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Rare constitutively active ARM-domain GoF variants enrich in human ALS (Gilley 2021 PMID:34796871; Bloom 2022 PMID:34991663; 7ANW/7DJT octamer inter-protomer ARM-TIR latch 3.07-5.47A vs 37.8-65.4A intra-chain, cumulative validated GoF AF=0.000378 [~0.076% carriers] vs benign P332Q AF=0.986%, 97 hom; 0/12 single-gene SARM1 ClinVar P/LP [6 opposite-strand SLC46A1 records]), executing Wallerian NAD+ catastrophe; elevated protein in small-sample C9FTD iPSC neurons (+0.675, p=0.0268, n=3 vs 3); no population depletion of heterozygous pLoF variants in Open Targets / legacy constraint (obs/exp=60/65.1, LOEUF=1.143) or gnomAD v4.1 MANE (obs/exp=60/52.6, LOEUF=1.413; distinct from biallelic KO phenotyping).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Postmortem end-stage bulk RNA is lower (-0.307) due to projection-neuron dropout, clinical SARM1 space now spans three Ph1/2 programs — Disarm-lineage orthosteric base-exchange prodrug Lilly LY3873862 (NCT07883590 [Ph1 Not Yet Recruiting], PMID:33406435), oral reversible orthosteric inhibitor Nura/TRICALS NB-4746 (NCT07369076, undisclosed structure), and Sironax oral allosteric inhibitor SIR2501 (CTR20253552 China ALS Ph1b/2a, NCT07765446 US paclitaxel CIPN Ph2 n=18, ANZCTR 387449 HV SAD/MAD N=82 up to 600 mg/150 mg QD, ASCO 2026 10.1200/JCO.2026.44.16_suppl.12148, SfN 2026 PSTR091 15 Nov 2026 unreviewed congress poster; WO2024125624A1/WO2024222835A1/WO2026086928A1) plus preclinical ASHA-624 — 2026 Commun Chem (PMID:42156967, PDB 9TZY) warns orthosteric BEXi scaffolds risk paradoxical sub-inhibitory SARM1 activation (0.05x-0.30x Kd), undisclosed SIR2501 structure leaves unresolved chronic thiol-reactive Cys311 ARM covalency (PDB 7DJT class, PMID:33944777) vs reversible non-covalent ARM/ARM-TIR T-lock (ASHA-624 class), and healthy-volunteer circulating plasma cADPR (ASCO #12148) is >90-95% ecto-CD38/BST1-generated (PMID:32087251; PMID:16750163) while CIPN DRGs lie outside the BBB.
factual_justification: Core Track B target backed by human ALS rare GoF genetics, parallel axonal protection alongside STMN2 (Krus et al. 2022 PMID:35767949), elevated C9-FTD iPSC neuronal protein (+0.675, p=0.0268, n=6, PMID:42789089), and low heterozygous pLoF constraint (Open Targets LOEUF=1.143; gnomAD v4.1 MANE LOEUF=1.413); despite clinical activity across 3 programs (LY3873862 NCT07883590 [ALS Ph1 Not Yet Recruiting; HV NCT05492201 N=84 completed], NB-4746 NCT07369076, SIR2501 CTR20253552/NCT07765446), CNS-penetrant non-covalent inter-protomer ARM-TIR T-lock glues (ASHA-624 class; covalent Cys311 PDB 7DJT as structural benchmark) avoid biphasic base-exchange activation.
discriminating_next_test: Prioritize CNS-penetrant reversible non-covalent inter-protomer ARM-TIR T-lock glues (ASHA-624 class; verifying Cys311-independent binding via Cys311Ala SARM1 vs covalent Cys311 PDB 7DJT benchmark and benchmarking undisclosed allosteric SIR2501 [CTR20253552 ALS Ph1b/2a, NCT07765446 CIPN Ph2, SfN 2026 PSTR091]) head-to-head against Disarm-lineage 3-chain TIR-gluing base-exchange inhibitor (BEXi) prodrugs (PDB 9TZY, LY3873862 NCT07883590, PMID:33406435, PMID:42156967) and empirically decoupled reversible orthosteric NB-4746 (NCT07369076) across full trough-to-peak and 48-72 h simulated oral CNS washout curves (5x -> 0.03x IC50, modeling missed doses in bulbar dysphagia) in microfluidic WT, Cys311Ala, and isogenic SARM1 p.L223P ARM-GoF negative-control human sALS motor axons +/- STMN2 splice rescue (bracketing the 1.00x parallel microtubule-remodeling Bliss survival lower bound per 10.64898/2026.11.07.764673 [PREPRINT] & PMID:35767949 against the ~2-7x [med ~3x, MODEL_PRIOR] NMNAT2-epistatic MWC upper bound), paired with enzymatic ecto-CD38/BST1 counter-screening (since >90-95% CD38-derived basal fluid cADPR caps 90% selective SARM1 blockade at ~5-10% drop so a -50% cell-free plasma drop implies ~45-50% CD38 inhibition [MODEL_PRIOR], PMID:32087251/PMID:16750163, while CIPN DRGs lie outside the BBB) and anchoring human Phase 1b PD on unbound CSF Ctrough,u >= IC80 (Kp,uu >= 0.30), zero washout CSF pNfH/plasma NfL spike, and exploratory L1CAM/ATP1A3+ neuron-derived EV cADPR:NAD+ while reserving SARM1 KD ASO (PMID:40473123; given ~30-40% residual NADase ceiling [MODEL_PRIOR] at 100x Kd in Binomial hetero-octamer d_lock=6.5 GoF heterozygotes) for <1% ARM-broken GoF carriers.

name: Low-Dose Aldesleukin (IL-2) in Low-pNfH Stratum
evidence_proves_hypothesis: In MIROCALS Phase 2b (NCT03039673, PMID:40354799, Lancet May 2025, N=220 randomized of 304 screened, 90 deaths; primary unadjusted ITT HR=0.81, 95% CI 0.54-1.22, p=0.33; CHEMBL1201438), SAP-prespecified covariate-adjusted Cox + continuous CSF pNfH x Treatment modeling was positive (adj HR=0.32, 95% CI 0.14-0.73, p=0.0070; interaction HR=1.0003/pg/mL, p=0.0011; secondary ALSFRS-R slope interaction F=3.95, p=0.048), with 48% 21-mo mortality hazard reduction in the visually defined (mmc1.pdf pp. 13, 23, blinded to survival) 750-3,700 pg/mL BioVendor ELISA stratum (n=154, 57 deaths, HR=0.52, 95% CI 0.30-0.89, p=0.016; <750 pg/mL LLOQ n=19 had 0 deaths; pooled <=3,700 pg/mL n=173/220 [78.6% LP / 56.9% of 304 screened] HR=0.57, 95% CI 0.33-0.97, p=0.037) alongside sustained Day-112 trough FOXP3+ Treg expansion (p<0.0001) and plasma CCL2 reduction (p<0.05 at Day-112 trough, p<0.0001 at Days 8 & 120; CSF CCL2/pNfH NS at Day 112); Al Khleifat et al. 2026 (PMID:42836993, PMC13642438, J Neurol 273:643) showed inside MIROCALS (N=220) that clinical TRICALS risk shares only r^2=12.7% (r=0.357) of variance with CSF pNfH and contributes less treatment-interaction information (nested dChi2=4.76, LRT p=0.029 / Wald p=0.025 vs dChi2=14.24 for pNfH x treatment; adding pNfH to TRICALS dChi2=44.39; combined model reference HR=0.28, 95% CI 0.12-0.63, p=0.002).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Primary unadjusted ITT log-rank test missed significance (HR=0.81, 95% CI 0.54-1.22, p=0.33; >3,700 pg/mL n=47 [33/90 deaths] showed no demonstrated benefit HR=1.37, 95% CI 0.68-2.75, p=0.38, and 3,700 pg/mL was visually selected from baseline CSF pNfH distribution rather than externally pre-locked), IL2/IL2RA has 0 human ALS genetics, EMA/MHRA/UK MND CSG declined approval pending Phase 3 proof, commercial pNfH immunoassays exhibit ~1.8x-4.5x inter-platform pg/mL calibrator offsets (PMID:31251725; PMID:29054919; cf. BioVendor ELISA in PMID:40354799 vs MSD ECLIA cited in PMID:42836993), Phase 2/3 ALSTARS (NCT07161999, N=137 enrolled, prospectively stratified across 3 baseline serum NfL tiers on 24-wk ALSFRS-R) tests dual-biologic COYA 302 (1 MIU rhIL-2 + 125 mg CTLA4-Ig q14d vs q28d; <0.5% BBB entry, CD28 blockade PMID:30683697/PMID:36920087 vs IL-2 STAT5 rescue PMID:42086904) without baseline CSF pNfH exclusion or a single-agent IL-2 arm, ALS FOXP3+ Tregs risk TSDR methylation drift + NK/eosinophil/sCD25 sinks, and zero prospective Phase 3 trials gated on calibrated CSF pNfH <=3,700 pg/mL have completed.
factual_justification: Under Epistemic Asymmetry, covariate-adjusted survival benefit (HR=0.32, p=0.0070) and <=3,700 pg/mL BioVendor ELISA benefit (750-3,700 HR=0.52, p=0.016, n=154; pooled <=3,700 HR=0.57, p=0.037, n=173) inside an unadjusted-ITT-null Phase 2b trial (MIROCALS PMID:40354799, HR=0.81, p=0.33) with zero IL2/IL2RA ALS genetics require prospective biomarker-gated Phase 3 confirmation.
discriminating_next_test: Complete pre-Phase-3 CLSI EP09c (N>=40 paired ALS CSFs spanning the measuring interval) Passing-Bablok analytical bridging from MIROCALS BioVendor ELISA CSF pNfH (~79th percentile, <=3,700 pg/mL: n=173/220 [78.6% post-run-in LP yield; 173/304 = 56.9% initial-screen yield]) to automated CLIA immunoassays (Ella/Euroimmun/Simoa/MSD; resolving ~1.8x-4.5x inter-platform calibrator offsets, PMID:31251725, PMID:29054919; cf. Al Khleifat 2026 PMID:42836993 where TRICALS shares r^2=12.7% with CSF pNfH and nested pNfH x trt dChi2=14.24 vs TRICALS x trt dChi2=4.76), plus paired immunoassay validation before substituting blood NfL or pNfH for CSF pNfH (noting Trautwig 2025 PMC12082929 tryptic CSF MS NEFL-NEFH r=0.278 across n=77 DIA / n=51 overlapping Emory TMT vs clinical immunoassay serum NfL-CSF pNfH rho=0.64-0.71 PMID:38683209 and serum NfL outperforming serum pNfH on ALSFRS-R slope PMID:32385188; post-hoc NX210c SEALS NCT06365216 NfL<=95 pg/mL p=0.062; note enrolled N=137 ALSTARS NCT07161999 stratifies 3 serum NfL tiers on 24-wk ALSFRS-R with dual-biologic rhIL-2 + CTLA4-Ig and no single-agent IL-2 arm, so ALSTARS cannot directly falsify single-agent S07), then execute an event-driven Phase 3 RCT powered for 247 deaths at assumed true HR=0.70 (80.0% two-sided alpha=0.05 superiority power, critical boundary HR_crit=0.779 [50% probability of point estimate <=0.70 at true HR=0.70]; 138 deaths at HR=0.62 [MODEL_PRIOR]; N~650-750 over 36-42 mo variable follow-up or N~850-1,050 at 24 mo, <5% vital-status censoring, accounting for 0 deaths in <750 pg/mL n=19/220 MIROCALS LLOQ floor and pre-specifying complementary TRICALS + log[CSF pNfH] covariates — whereas hypothetical unbridged 1.8x-4.5x lower CSF cutoffs admit 74-99% of >3,700 pg/mL patients and reduce 247-death one-sided superiority power to ~43-50% if HR_high=1.00 or ~14-23% if HR_high=1.37 [MODEL_PRIOR]) enrolling calibrated ~79th-percentile CSF pNfH <=3,700 pg/mL with longitudinal Treg TSDR (PMID:17694575), CD56bright NK, and serum sCD25 (PMID:32651161; PMID:22343569) monitoring.

name: Ultrahigh-Dose Methylcobalamin (Rozebalamin)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Phase 3 JETALS RCT (NCT03548311, Oki et al. 2022 JAMA Neurol PMID:35532908, N=130 randomized / N=129 FAS [65 vs 64] / 126 Wk-16 completers, <=12m from symptom onset, 50 mg IM 2x/wk; CHEMBL4297672) slowed 16-wk MMRM ALSFRS-R decline by 43% (+1.97 pts, -2.66 vs -4.63, 95% CI 0.44-3.50, exact p=0.012; +2.11 pts [p=0.01] in n=116 concomitant riluzole) and lowered plasma homocysteine (-37.2%, p<0.001), confirming Kaji et al. 2019's <=12m stratum (PMID:30636701, n=144 HR=0.498, p<0.025) and earning Japan MHLW approval on Sept 24, 2024 (Rozebalamin 25 mg x2 vials = 50 mg IM twice weekly).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Prior broad-window (<=3 yr onset) Phase 2/3 RCT missed overall co-primaries (Kaji et al. 2019 PMID:30636701, NCT00444613, N=373 randomized / N=370 FAS: 50 mg survival p=0.087, ALSFRS-R p=0.19), 16-wk JETALS secondary FVC (p=0.39) was non-significant and Rozebalamin remains unapproved by FDA/EMA (0 active US/EU Phase 3 trials), and unshielded 2.5 uM methylcobalamin (~2.1-2.3x human 50 mg IM plasma Cmax ~1.1-1.2 uM) scored -3.60d (q=0.00246, Rank #105/107) in Bye 2025, plausibly via ~450-488 nm live-imaging Co-C bond photolysis into aquo/hydroxocobalamin + methyl/ROS radicals.
factual_justification: Reclassified as a regionally approved Standard-of-Care (SOC) clinical benchmark (Japan MHLW Sept 24, 2024 Rozebalamin 50 mg IM twice weekly for ALS functional slowing, anchored in JETALS <=12m onset N=129 FAS +1.97 ALSFRS-R pts, p=0.012, PMID:35532908) and iPSC-screen Co-C photolability calibration benchmark.
discriminating_next_test: Account for concomitant 50 mg IM mecobalamin use when stratifying Japanese/East-Asian ALS trial cohorts (<=12m onset), and pair dark-shielded vs ~450-488 nm blue-light-irradiated + hydroxocobalamin controls in live-imaging iPSC-MN screens.

name: Censavudine (TPN-101) in ALS-TE Subtype
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Phase 2a NCT04993755 (mixed N=42 C9orf72-ALS + FTD safety cohort, 400 mg/d PO TPN-101 / CHEMBL124363; alongside completed PSP Ph2a NCT04993768 N=42 & AGS Ph2 ISG program) reported favorable safety, reduced CSF IL-6 & NfL, ~50% slower 24-wk vital capacity decline in the C9-ALS subgroup (-8.4% vs -16.5% placebo), and May 2025 selection of TPN-101 for the Phase 2/3 HEALEY ALS Platform Trial; within motor ALS cortex, ALS-TE elevates IFNAR2 both vs ALS-Ox (+0.2793, p=6.32e-8, GC+cellcomp adj_p=3.87e-9, AUC=0.7698) and vs Control (+0.1920, p=6.62e-4, adj_p=0.0376) while retaining intact TYK2 (+0.5763 vs Ox, p=5.52e-9) and STAT2 (+0.3103 vs Ox, p=5.14e-8).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Primary re-analysis of O'Neill 2025 (DS001_ONEILL) shows cortical ALS-TE prevalence is 13.40% (41/306 all cortical motor-ALS donors; 13.53% = 41/303 excluding 3 multi-region discordant donors; 11.52% in non-C9 sALS), spinal cord ALS-TE is 0.00% (0/331 donors, masked by ventral-horn gliosis/ox), and postmortem cortical ALS-TE TYK2 (-0.0732, p=0.465) & STAT2 (+0.0153, p=0.798) plus bulk ISGs (ISG15/IFIT1/MX1/OAS1/IRF9) are flat vs Control, while NCT04993755 remains unpublished in peer-reviewed form, no validated living-CSF ALS-TE enrichment assay exists for HEALEY Ph2/3 sporadic enrollment, nucleoside prodrug TPN-101 requires intracellular TPN-101-TP triphosphorylation (post-mitotic MN vs glial dCK/kinase efficiency unmeasured), and backup BHV-8000 is a dual TYK2/JAK1 (JH1) inhibitor rather than a JAK1-sparing TYK2-JH2 allosteric binder.
factual_justification: Oral LINE-1 RT inhibitor TPN-101 (TRL_5; selected May 2025 for Phase 2/3 HEALEY ALS Platform Trial following mixed N=42 C9orf72-ALS/FTD Phase 2a NCT04993755 & PSP NCT04993768) showed encouraging C9-ALS subgroup biomarker (CSF IL-6/NfL) and vital-capacity signals, and cortical ALS-TE elevates IFNAR2 above Control, yet efficacy in sporadic ALS-TE remains unproven pending peer-reviewed NCT04993755 publication, living-CSF ORF1p/L1HS enrichment for the ~13.4-13.5% cortical ALS-TE subgroup (0/331 bulk cord), and post-mitotic human MN vs glial TPN-101-TP triphosphorylation verification.
discriminating_next_test: Anchor Phase 2/3 HEALEY ALS Platform Trial sporadic biomarker stratification by disaggregating three biological layers alongside peer-reviewed NCT04993755 C9-ALS vs FTD publication and human iPSC-MN vs microglial TPN-101-TP LC-MS/MS phosphorylation verification: (1) cryptic HDGFL2 (PMID:38278991/PMID:42854693) solely as the upstream pan-TDP-43 pathology gate, (2) direct retroelement cargo (CSF/plasma LINE-1 ORF1p Simoa PMID:40050409 + CSF EV L1HS RNA/cDNA) as the subtype-specific ALS-TE enrichment gate calibrated to 13.40% (41/306; 13.53% = 41/303 non-discordant; 11.52% non-C9 sALS) cortical prevalence, and (3) ultrasensitive CSF IL-6 + cGAS-STING/pSTAT2/ISG activity as longitudinal PD before testing dual TYK2/JAK1 JH1 inhibition (BHV-8000, which also blocks gp130/JAK1-STAT3) vs selective allosteric TYK2-JH2 probes.
